# Kokonut UI Smooth Tab

Source: https://kokonutui.com/docs/navigation/smooth-tab.md
Author: Dorian Baffier. MIT; see LICENSE.
Retrieved September 14, 2026. The public source is preserved in `smooth-tab.md`.

`src/app/components/ui/kokonut/SmoothChoice.tsx` adapts the component's animated
selection and spring interaction to the optimizer's radio groups. It uses native
radios (including arrow-key navigation), a Motion layout indicator that supports
two-column grids, the portfolio palette, and reduced-motion preferences.
The demo content, fixed width and decorative wave animation are omitted.
